title: loop transition
system_instruction_addendum: LOOP TRANSITION ADDENDUM: A loop on deck a buys time while deck b enters. Loop in, crossfade across, loop out. State the bar length of the loop.

tutor_speak.text: a loop buys you bars. drop a four-bar loop on deck a, bring deck b in over it, then let deck a's loop go.
tap loop in on deck a — the deck holds the next four bars on repeat.
while the loop runs, crossfade to deck b.

hints.text: the loop in button sits near the pad row on deck a.
tap loop in once — the deck repeats from that moment.
press loop in on deck a now.
